method: fitted, not clicked: `npm run rooms:panel` fits a line to each of the four straight runs of the floor's gold perimeter trim and intersects adjacent pairs. Every corner of this room is chamfered — a brazier stands on the near cut, a pier closes the far one — so the rectangle's corners are not points the art draws.
confidence: corners good to ~0.15 px rms over 94-136 samples per run. The panel itself is the limit: its opposite runs are 17.6% and 24.6% from parallel, so it was not drawn in a parallel projection and no exact inversion of it exists.
